I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket is **PD-4821**, the one with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply.

I found it in #central-team, which Tobias belongs to. Hollis posted it there on 2026-06-09. I also mentioned the issue Hollis flagged with it: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be sorted before anyone reimported. A ticket number is an operational fact, so it was fine to share in the channel.
